title: Vehicle battery usage by supplier
measure: Share of battery energy in registered EV, PHEV and HEV vehicles
calculation: Other suppliers = 100 − 39.4 − 15.1 − 8.1 − 5.3 − 4.9 = 27.2%; the five named suppliers total 72.8%
discrepancy_note: SNE publishes CATL plus BYD at 54.6%; its one-decimal company values sum to 54.5%. The reason is unverified. Company values are not renormalised. Other suppliers is the complement of the five shown, not the source table’s separate Others category.

source.title: Global EV and Battery Monthly Tracker — January to August 2026
source.classification: Third-party estimates; original supplier table and figures actually read

alt_text: Ring chart of January–August 2026 vehicle battery energy usage across 80 countries: CATL 39.4%, BYD 15.1%, LG Energy Solution 8.1%, CALB 5.3%, Gotion 4.9%, and other suppliers 27.2%. Total 844.2 GWh. Source SNE Research; stationary storage excluded.
